# Orthofeet

> Orthofeet specializes in podiatrist-recommended orthopedic shoes and orthotics designed to relieve foot pain from plantar fasciitis, bunions, arthritis, and other conditions.

Orthofeet offers a comprehensive collection of women's orthopedic footwear across multiple styles—from sneakers and casual shoes to dress shoes, boots, and sandals—all featuring the proprietary Ortho-Cushion System with arch support and wide toe boxes. The company backs its products with a 60-day wear test, free shipping, and flexible return/exchange policies.
